package rulefixtures

import "errors"

// scenario for errors_new_for_static_sentinel: `errors.New("some error")` called repeatedly in hot paths instead of a package-level sentinel
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func processRequest(records []string) error {
	for _, record := range records {
		if record == "" {
			return errors.New("invalid input")
		}
		if record == "timeout" {
			return errors.New("operation timed out")
		}
	}
	return nil
}
